dimensions.assessment: The resolution affects digital marketing providers and consumers interacting with them through the Bureau of Consumer Financial Protection rule.
It invalidates a federal agency rule regarding digital marketing providers under the Consumer Financial Protection Act.
No specific federal spending or revenue changes are stated in the text.
The change nullifies a specific agency rule and its withdrawal regarding time or space exceptions.
The rule disapproval is permanent in its regulatory effect nationwide.
